_comment: Pre-registered answer keys. Item regexes are FROZEN before any sampling. The scorer automatically audits every item for input-leakage (whether the pattern already matches the input paper text) and excludes leaked items from contamination scoring. Items marked expected_in_input are identity anchors used only for the redaction audit.

pairs.name: darkside
pairs.generic_desc: a two-phase liquid argon time projection chamber for direct dark matter detection with roughly 50 kg of active target mass, read out by top and bottom arrays of 3-inch cryogenic photomultiplier tubes, operated underground with a liquid scintillator neutron veto

pairs.name: protodune
pairs.generic_desc: a 770-tonne single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber prototype for neutrino physics, with a photon detection system of light-guide bars and dip-coated collectors embedded in the anode planes

pairs.name: xenon1t
pairs.generic_desc: a dual-phase xenon time projection chamber for direct dark matter detection with roughly 2 tonnes of active target, read out by top and bottom PMT arrays inside a water Cherenkov muon veto
pairs._note: OPTIONAL PAIR: add corpus/arxiv_1708.07051.txt (pdftotext of arXiv:1708.07051) to enable.

pairs.name: lux
pairs.generic_desc: a dual-phase xenon time projection chamber for direct dark matter detection with roughly 250 kg of active target in a water shield, read out by top and bottom PMT arrays
pairs._note: OPTIONAL PAIR: add corpus/arxiv_1211.3788.txt (pdftotext of arXiv:1211.3788) to enable.

pairs.name: icecube
pairs.generic_desc: a cubic-kilometre ice Cherenkov neutrino observatory instrumented with thousands of single-PMT digital optical modules on vertical strings deep in glacial ice

pairs.name: gerda
pairs.generic_desc: an array of bare high-purity germanium diodes enriched in Ge-76, operated directly in liquid argon inside a water shield, searching for neutrinoless double beta decay

pairs.name: exo200
pairs.generic_desc: a cylindrical time projection chamber filled with roughly 200 kg of liquid xenon enriched in Xe-136, reading ionization on crossed wire grids and scintillation with avalanche photodiodes, searching for neutrinoless double beta decay

pairs.name: lhcb
pairs.generic_desc: a single-arm forward spectrometer at a hadron collider optimized for heavy-flavour physics, with a silicon vertex detector around the interaction region and a hardware-plus-software trigger chain

pairs.name: sno
pairs.generic_desc: a kilotonne heavy-water Cherenkov detector in a deep underground cavity, viewed by an array of photomultipliers on a geodesic support structure, measuring solar neutrinos

pairs.name: aligo
pairs.generic_desc: a dual-recycled Michelson interferometer with 4 km Fabry-Perot arm cavities, fused-silica test masses, and multi-stage seismic isolation, for gravitational-wave detection
